reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 8.1 is a full Vendor (Commerce One) defend-indemnify-hold-harmless for third-party claims that the Software infringes patent, copyright, trademark or trade secret rights, with standard notice/control/cooperation procedure and the procure/modify-replace/terminate-and-refund remedy ladder.

Exclusions in 8.2 are narrow (use outside Documentation; third-party modification but-for causation) and do not undercut the fallback; Section 9 expressly carves Section 8 liability out of both the 12-month fee cap and the consequential-damages exclusion, so the indemnity is uncapped — better than the fallback's 3x super-cap.
No reciprocal or one-way Customer indemnity exists to narrow, so nothing to redline; the deterministic check confirming a Vendor IP indemnity is consistent.

Consistent with the compliant treatment, no redline text was changed and no counterparty comment was emitted; the shortfalls versus preferred (no breach-of-law, data-breach, or gross negligence/wilful misconduct prongs; no express affiliate coverage) are correctly noted in the rationale as file notes rather than flagged as deviations.
